messages:
zoe: Quick sync: can we agree on a machine-readable bridge manifest and an exception playbook so CS/infra/legal can act predictably? Need something small we can ship this sprint.

ravi: +1. Manifest idea: a YAML/JSON policy per model in the catalog that declares allowed lanes, default TTLs, and region restrictions. Then infra can enforce caps programmatically.

marta: Suggested minimal manifest fields: model, version, allowed_lanes, default_ttl_days, reserved_memory_gb, contact_owners. e.g.
```
model: redwood-alpha
version: v2.1
allowed_lanes: [fast, standard, extended]
default_ttl_days: 90
reserved_memory_gb: 1.1
contact_owners: [team-ml, team-infra]
```

kevin: Ops constraints: we need global and regional soft caps and an enrollment pre-check endpoint that returns estimated memory impact + surcharge estimate. Also emit a billing_event when a bridge is approved.

sara: From product/CS: playbook should include negotiation bullets, default consumer offers, and a canned addendum for extended lanes. Suggestions:
- fast: 30d, free, migration workshop
- standard: 90d, discounted surcharge, migration credits (2w)
- extended: 180d+, paid, contract addendum required

ops-bot: INFO: current_pinned=46; global_soft_cap=150; estimated_reserved_per_pin_gb=1.2

ravi: Quality gates for manifest enrollment: embedding drift (mean cosine) <= 0.03, semantic pass rate >= 97% on curated set, p95 latency delta <= 12%. Fail = temporary enrollment only (14d).

marta: UI: "Request bridge" flow should POST manifest + bench link + justification. Approval flow: auto-approve if checks pass and caps available; else create an approval ticket for product+infra+legal. Emergency path: 14d emergency bridge with incident tag and 3-owner notification.

kevin: Billing: surcharge formula we can emit in manifest calc: surcharge_usd = reserved_memory_gb * rate_per_gb * ttl_months. We'll default rate_per_gb to 25 USD/gb-month until finance sets numbers.

sara: Negotiation playbook snippet for CS: offer standard lane + 2-week token credit; escalate to product for extended requests. If customer insists on >360d, require contract amendment and justify to finance for pass-through costs.

ravi: Monitoring: sample 1% of bridged traffic for daily regression score. If regression >2% over 24h OR error spike >1% over 1h, auto-flag and toggle graceful rollback.

marta: Action items:
- Ravi: manifest schema + enrollment API spec (ETA 3d)
- Kevin: quota + billing_event + surcharge calc (ETA 4d)
- Sara: CS negotiation playbook + addendum template (ETA 2d)
- Zoe: console wire for request flow (ETA 5d)

ops-bot: Created RW-PL-7921 and assigned to @zoe.

zoe: If nobody objects I'll open the epic and attach these tasks. Any pushback on manifest fields now?

ravi: None from ML. Schema looks good but require extension point for model-specific exceptions.

kevin: Fine from infra, just ensure the pre-check endpoint is fast (<2s).

sara: Fine from CS/legal. Will start addendum draft.
